newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ekovest unit gets construction project.
newsitem.headline: Ekovest unit gets construction project.

text.p: Malaysia's Ekovest Bhd said its associate company has received a letter of award to design and carry out infrastructure works for a university project at a contract value of 345 million ringgit.
The civil engineering and building firm said in a statement its 40 percent associate, Syabas Hakikat Sdn Bhd, received the award letter for the Sabah state project from the Malaysian government.
The 18-month contract is to be completed by November 1 next year.
